import.required: Name and Phone are required. Email, Address and Tax Code are optional.
import.phone: Phone must be exactly 10 digits and is unique per business.
import.unique: Email and Tax Code, when given, must each be unique — a value already used by another customer must be fixed before importing.
import.skip: A row whose phone matches an existing customer with the same name is skipped (already imported); the same phone under a different name must be fixed.
import.store: Imported customers are added to the current store.
